name: sizemyfile
description: Convert, compress and inspect files with ordered workflows. Rust edge processing with bounded server fallback.

interface.shortDescription: File tools for ordered, validated workflows
interface.longDescription: Discover 100 file tools. Use 62 remote operations for images, PDFs, data, models, archives and text. Connect a SizeMyFile account, explicitly share files, then process and download validated results. A separate local runner supports 96 tools on your own computer. File and account limits apply.
defaultPrompt: Convert my CSV to Parquet, then inspect the result.
Merge my PDFs, then extract the first page.
Convert this WebP to PNG and compress the converted file.
